adminCredits.title: Credit administration
adminCredits.description: Compensations and bonuses for users. Every grant is recorded in their history.
adminCredits.noAccess: This section requires credit administrator access.
adminCredits.permanent: Bonus credits have no expiry. Each grant must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
adminCredits.retryHint: The previous request has no confirmed response. Retry this same request to complete it without creating a duplicate grant.

errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in to your administrator account.
errors.CREDITS_ADMIN_REQUIRED: You do not have permission to grant credits.
errors.INVALID_ACCOUNT: Enter a valid email or UID.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: The user or their profile was not found.
errors.INVALID_COMPENSATION: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100,000 and a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
errors.BALANCE_INCONSISTENT: The balance does not match its credit records. This account needs a separate reconciliation before grants can continue.
errors.REQUEST_CONFLICT: This request ID belongs to a different operation. Check the history before making a new grant.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Allow storage for this site so an interrupted request can be retried safely.
errors.UNKNOWN: Could not confirm the result. If the grant was submitted, retry the same request using “Check and complete”.
